verdict.rationale: Godot explicitly advertises a dedicated 2D rendering engine with real pixel coordinates and 2D-specific nodes, alongside its general Node/Scene architecture, supporting 2D as a distinct workflow rather than a 3D byproduct. However, the evidence pack lacks specifics on tilemap editing tools or the 2D physics engine, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of 2D workflow quality is present. Missing for 10: documentation/community evidence on TileMap editor, 2D physics engine (Godot Physics 2D) details, and hands-on validation of 2D-specific workflows.
